question: Should ClawHub adopt this stricter no case-colliding SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md package rule now, and require matching docs/spec proof before merge?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the rule changes a documented package compatibility contract and adds PROTOCOL.md policy scope that maintainers need to own.

options.title: Adopt with docs and proof
options.body: Require a docs/spec update plus redacted live behavior proof, then merge the stricter validation once those are present.

options.title: Accept code-only compatibility break
options.body: Merge the stricter validation without further policy text, accepting the support risk for packages that currently rely on permissive behavior.

options.title: Pause for package-contract scope
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether PROTOCOL.md belongs in ClawHub's skill package validation contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt with docs and proof
recommendation.body: Require a docs/spec update plus redacted live behavior proof, then merge the stricter validation once those are present.
